description: True if Value is at least Start and less than End (End itself is outside the range).

languages.javascript:
if (start > end) throw new Error("Start can't be greater than End");
return value >= start && value < end;
languages.csharp:
if (start > end) throw new ArgumentException("Start can't be greater than End");
return value >= start && value < end;
languages.cpp:
if (start > end) throw std::invalid_argument("Start can't be greater than End");
return value >= start && value < end;
languages.rust:
if start > end { panic!("Start can't be greater than End"); }
return value >= start && value < end;
languages.java:
if (start > end) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Start can't be greater than End");
return value >= start && value < end;
